passages.title: UTBK Lab: Inference and Alternative Explanations
passages.text: Riko had rehearsed his presentation twice before the community meeting. As the first speaker finished, he noticed that the chair beside him was still empty. He checked his phone, looked toward the door, and quietly rearranged the note cards that he had already put in order. His partner had promised to bring a chart showing the project’s results. When she finally arrived with the chart, Riko smiled and placed the cards back on the table. He began speaking only after checking that the chart could be displayed.

choices: Riko intended to cancel the meeting permanently
Riko had never prepared his presentation
Riko disliked every person in the room
Riko was concerned about his partner and the chart before presenting
